name: Alessandro Rossi
bio:
Alessandro Rossi's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He began his career as a junior mechanic, quickly impressing his superiors with his technical aptitude and relentless work ethic. His leadership potential soon became evident, leading to roles in team management and strategy. He joined Oregon Team two years ago as a junior manager, rapidly ascending to the role of team principal due to his strategic acumen and ability to motivate the team under pressure. 

Alessandro is known for his data-driven approach to racing, meticulously analyzing every aspect of performance to find marginal gains. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team, constantly pushing his staff to innovate and refine their processes. His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire to achieve excellence and bring Oregon Team to the forefront of the motorsport world. He is also known for his sharp intuition during races, often making bold strategic calls that have yielded significant results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of intense focus, his piercing gaze conveys both determination and a hint of weariness.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a specific espresso blend he insists on having before every race.
Taps his pen rhythmically on the table when deep in thought.
